documents.reference: Leave Policy 2026 1. Sick Leave Employees get 12 sick leaves per year. A medical certificate is required for sick leave longer than 2 consecutive days. 2. Casual Leave Employees get 8 casual leaves per year. Casual leave must be applied at least 1 day in advance through the HR portal. Leave Summary Leave Type Days per Year Carry Forward Sick Leave 12 No Casual Leave 8 No Earned Leave 18 Yes, up to 30 days 3. Maternity and Paternity Leave Maternity leave is 26 weeks. Paternity leave is 10 working days, to be taken within 3 months of the child's birth. 4. Notice Period The notice period for all permanent employees is 60 days.

CODE OF CONDUCT 1. Treat every colleague with respect. 2. Office hours are 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM. 3. Report any harassment to hr@acme-example.com. 4. Company laptops must be locked when unattended. DRESS CODE Business casual from Monday to Thursday. Friday is casual dress day. Approved by: HR Head, Acme Example Pvt Ltd
